metadata.summary: Jiten ordered a Multigrain Bagel with cheddar cheese and avocado from Manhattan Bagel.

messages.text: Hello Jiten, welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It's great to see you again. What would you like to order?
Actually, I'm looking to order, something crispy and vegetarian bagel, kind of multigrain bagel.
And, with the cheddar cheese, also avocado. Can you please get or else maybe you can have plain cheese, plain cream cheese as well. Can I get something?

I can definitely get that with some cheddar cheese and avocado for you.
